g.text: An address swap and an item change through the J++ lens, against 200 random vectors of the same size
9B, 27B, Muse: descriptive. Lightning: descriptive, dashed; its address swap's share rebuilt ends just past
the strip; hatched: its own random range, where it sits off the strip. 122B: not run.
Hollow marks: Lightning's gate chosen after the 60-scene pre-check was seen.
